title: The Fateful First Consumer Review
authors: Sungsik Park; Woochoel Shin; Jinhong Xie
eligible_reason: No staggered binary treatment and no unit FE: the regressions take cross-platform differences (Amazon minus BestBuy, Amazon US minus Canada) of average rating or review volume for the same product and regress them on the difference in first-review negativity (values -1/0/1) interacted with log(period), with price, word-count, search-volume and residual controls (lm, clustered by product).
design_notes: replication/1_vac_am_bb.R ... 4_cam_us_can.R: Table 6 main valence spec lm(ar_am-ar_bb ~ I(neg1_am-neg1_bb)*log(period) + controls); Table 9 interacts the difference with period dummies; Tables 7 and 11 volume regressions; Table 12 second differencing with lagged volumes. The first-review sign is fixed at product launch, not a switching treatment.
data_files_note: Product-period analysis files for four category-platform pairs shipped as RData.
data_provenance_note: Scraped review data, shipped as analysis files.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; table mapping from code comments.
